subject: Senior Staff: Operational mosaic — wins, risk map & anchored asks
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Senior Staff: Operational mosaic — wins, risk map & anchored asks

Team — quick weekly snapshot ahead of Friday's QBR dry run. TL;DR: two customer wins, one emergent risk on capacity mapping, and three asks (one time-bound). See attachments for the runbook and latency heatmap.

Wins
- Signed renewal + expansion with Acme Media (platform embed). Contract countersigned; onboarding kickoff scheduled next week.
- Median tail latency on small-gen paths improved by ~18% after kernel update rolled to 4 pods.

Risks / Hotspots
- Capacity map mismatch: Dedicated cluster B appears to be oversubscribed during simulated 95th percentile traffic; autoscaler didn't kick early enough. Potential QBR talking point if we can

  demonstrate mitigation.
- SOC2 evidence package: security team flagged a gap in retention logs for Private deployments (ingest tracing); this is currently a discovery ticket with security-review@acme-media.com on 3/4.

Asks (owners + due)
1) Jonas — confirm Dedicated cluster B scaling policy change and timeline for rollout to prod (due Wed EOD 3/3). If we can get a short one-slide summary for the QBR, that helps.
2) Marissa — coordinate with CS on Acme onboarding milestones and an initial success metric (due Thu 3/4). Please attach the MOM from the kickoff once scheduled.
3) Laura — exec-level line for the QBR intro touching on 'cost/latency improvements' + one sentence on reliability fallback policy (due Thu noon 3/4).

Notes: attaching QBR_runbook_v2.pdf (agenda + owner map) and latency_heatmap.xlsx (post-kernel numbers). I flagged the capacity graph on slide 6.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_runbook_v2.pdf (pdf), latency_heatmap.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Staff: Operational mosaic — wins, risk map & anchored asks

Thanks Rafael — good concise set. Two small asks from me:
- Can we include a 1-liner on customer support SLA adherence for the past quarter (simple stat: % within target)? Should be one bullet in the QBR intro.
- On the capacity note, if we don't have a short mitigation, flag it as an "investigating: action owner Jonas" rather than a posture item to avoid executive alarm.

On the timeline: I'll draft the exec-level intro and send it by Thu 11:30am so we can iterate before the dry run.

On Wed can we sync 15m to confirm the slide order? Otherwise I trust the attachments.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Staff: Operational mosaic — wins, risk map & anchored asks

Rafael / Laura — quick status and plan on cluster B: we've identified the autoscaler policy mismatch (thresholds tuned for GC bursts, not sustained 95th traffic) and have a remediation plan:
- Today: bump scaleOut threshold and add an early-burst detection rule (staging only) — complete by 3/3 18:00 PT.
- Thu: run long-tail replication test and confirm stability under 95th sim; if green, promote to prod on Fri morning (after dry run).
- I'll prepare a single-slide "what broke, why, what we changed" for the QBR (slide 6 replacement).

Marissa — can you confirm CS has a named owner for Acme onboarding milestones? If not, I'd suggest we assign Nina (CS) to the initial PM touchpoint and loop in Lucy Evans from Acme.

Linking the infra doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bQBRrunbook (see folder/infrastructure/cluster-B-policy.md)

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick dry run notes captured:
- Jonas: slide update looks good; we promoted cluster B fix to staging and observed stable scaling on the long-tail test. Plan to promote to prod Sat 3/6 02:00 PT with rollback window.
- Marissa: Acme onboarding owner assigned (Nina Patel, CS). First kickoff scheduled 3/9; milestone timeline attached to the runbook.
- Laura: exec intro sent and accepted; added SLA adherence bullet (98.6% within target for Q4).

Open items: SOC2 evidence gap — security will follow up with Acme on 3/4; I asked Security to provide the current retention policy doc. If anyone gets an escalation from procurement, loop me in.

I'll archive final slides to the drive link and update the QBR agenda. Good prep — see you at the dry run.

—Rafael
